name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.201
notes: Fixed a bug where the pacing-based push reminder could get silently canceled if the app was reopened while at or behind pace, with no named fluid event to fall back on.

The app now only actively cancels a scheduled push reminder when the fluid day is genuinely complete. Otherwise, if there is no fresh suggestion available right now, any previously scheduled reminder is left untouched instead of being wiped.
label: NoSpuriousCancel
summary: Fixes a bug where reopening the app while at or behind fluid pace could silently cancel an already-scheduled push reminder before it fired.
fixes: cbSyncFluidReminder(null) was being called whenever the pacing engine had no fresh ahead-of-pace suggestion, even mid-day, canceling any previously scheduled reminder. Fixed: only cancels on genuine fluid-day completion.
changes: The push sync block now distinguishes no-fresh-candidate from genuinely-done-for-the-day, and only cancels in the latter case.
No unrelated CardiacLens behavior was intentionally changed.
testing: Verified new logic in isolation for syntax and bracket balance.
Not yet verified: live push delivery through a full day of normal app use, including periods at/behind pace. Test this before relying on it.
